overview_description.description: HOT Technologies is a subscription-based fitness application that makes fitness accessible and rewarding by putting exceptional workouts in your hands so that you can train anytime and anywhere. It includes thousands of hours of curated and localized fitness content. For instance, they host a daily schedule of live classes that cater to different levels and goals. During a live class, the coaches will challenge attendees, call their names during class, and invite them to their next classes. HOT will soon be launching exclusive content for guided personal training sessions, alongside other features.
